metadata.title: Set Up PostgreSQL Database and SQLAlchemy ORM

story.iWant: PostgreSQL configured with SQLAlchemy ORM and Alembic migrations
story.soThat: I have a production-grade relational database ready for user-specific data storage

task.title: Set Up PostgreSQL in Devcontainer Docker Compose
task.subtask: Update .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml to add PostgreSQL 16 service
Configure PostgreSQL environment variables (POSTGRES_USER=nomi, POSTGRES_PASSWORD=nomi, POSTGRES_DB=nomi)
Map PostgreSQL port 5432 to host
Add persistent volume for PostgreSQL data
Update .devcontainer/devcontainer.json to depend on the db service
Verify PostgreSQL starts automatically when devcontainer launches

task.title: Configure PostgreSQL Connection and SQLAlchemy
task.subtask: Create app/core/database.py with async SQLAlchemy engine and session factory
Create declarative Base class for ORM models
Add DATABASE_URL to .env.example with PostgreSQL connection string format
Update app/core/config.py to load DATABASE_URL from environment
Configure async connection pool (min 5, max 20 connections)
Test database connection by importing database module in main.py

task.title: Initialize Alembic for Migrations
task.subtask: Run alembic init alembic to create migration directory structure
Configure alembic.ini to use DATABASE_URL from environment
Update alembic/env.py to import Base from app.core.database
Update alembic/env.py to support async migrations
Verify alembic can connect to database with alembic current

task.title: Create Users Table Model and Migration
task.subtask: Create app/features/users/ directory structure
Create app/features/users/model.py with User SQLAlchemy model

Define User model fields: id (UUID primary key), email (VARCHAR 255, unique, indexed), name (VARCHAR 255), entraid_user_id (VARCHAR 255, unique, indexed), created_at (TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE), updated_at (TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE)
Generate migration with alembic revision --autogenerate -m "Create users table"
Review generated migration script for accuracy
Apply migration with alembic upgrade head
Verify users table exists in PostgreSQL with correct schema

task.title: Test Database Integration
task.subtask: Create basic integration test in tests/test_database.py
Test database connection acquisition from pool
Test alembic current command returns migration version
Verify users table schema matches model definition
Document database setup steps in README.md

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given the devcontainer environment When I start the devcontainer Then PostgreSQL is automatically running via docker-compose
And the backend project structure exists When I configure the database connection Then I can connect to PostgreSQL (local or Docker)
And SQLAlchemy is configured with a base model class
And Alembic is initialized for database migrations
And I have a users table schema defined with fields: id (UUID), email, name, entraid_user_id, created_at, updated_at
And I can run alembic upgrade head to apply migrations
And Database connection settings are environment-based (.env file)

docs.doc: Defines SQLAlchemy async patterns with AsyncSession, database.py structure with create_async_engine and async_sessionmaker, User model with UUID primary key and proper indexes.
PostgreSQL schema for users table with UUID primary keys, entraid_user_id, email, name, timestamps. Includes index definitions for performance.
FastAPI 0.121.1, SQLAlchemy 2.0.44 async, PostgreSQL 16+, psycopg v3 async driver. Specifies use of AsyncSession and modern ORM patterns.
Database setup as foundational infrastructure. Prerequisites for authentication (Epic 2) and data models (Epics 3-4).
Vertical slice architecture with app/features/ organization. Naming conventions: snake_case for Python, PascalCase for classes, UUID primary keys pattern.

Environment template already has DATABASE_URL configured for postgresql connection. Story will update to use asyncpg driver.

package.name: asyncpg
package.note: May need to add for async PostgreSQL driver

service.name: postgres
service.note: To be added to devcontainer docker-compose.yml

constraints.constraint: Use async SQLAlchemy patterns throughout: AsyncSession, async with statements, create_async_engine. No synchronous database operations.
Follow vertical slice architecture: User model goes in app/features/users/model.py, not app/models/user.py
All tables use UUID primary keys with PostgreSQL gen_random_uuid() default
All tables require created_at and updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE fields
Foreign keys must be indexed for query performance
Database credentials via environment variables only (DATABASE_URL in .env)
For devcontainer: DATABASE_URL uses hostname 'db' (docker-compose service name). For local: use 'localhost'
Alembic configured for async migrations with proper env.py setup importing Base metadata
Database: snake_case tables and columns. Python: snake_case files/functions, PascalCase classes
Use pytest with pytest-asyncio for async test support. Integration tests verify database connectivity and schema.

interfaces.interface: Dependency injection pattern for FastAPI endpoints. Yields async database session, ensures cleanup with finally block.
Declarative base class for all ORM models. Import this in model files to define SQLAlchemy models.
Global async SQLAlchemy engine created with create_async_engine. Configured with connection pool (min 5, max 20).
SQLAlchemy ORM model for users table. Fields: id (UUID), entraid_user_id (str), email (str), name (str), created_at, updated_at.

tests.standards: Use pytest as test framework with pytest-asyncio plugin for async test support. Integration tests verify database connectivity, session factory, and schema. Tests should use test database, not production. Verify Alembic migrations apply cleanly.
tests.locations: tests/ directory at nomi-backend/tests/. Test files follow pattern test_*.py. Database tests in tests/test_database.py

ideas.idea: Test that PostgreSQL service starts automatically when devcontainer launches. Verify with docker ps or pg_isready command.
Integration test: Create async session from get_db(), verify connection succeeds, verify session closes properly.
Test that Base class can be imported and subclassed. Verify metadata contains User table definition.
Test alembic current command returns version. Test alembic upgrade head succeeds without errors.
After migration: Query users table schema from PostgreSQL, verify columns match User model (id UUID, entraid_user_id VARCHAR, etc.)
Test alembic downgrade and upgrade cycle. Verify idempotency of migrations.
Test DATABASE_URL loads from .env file correctly. Test connection fails gracefully with invalid credentials.
